title: Fix Vscode Extension Uri Resolution and Navigation
description: The semio repo vscode extension should properly resolve all URIs and navigate to them. Clicking on a URI should navigate to the resource, clicking on a tree item should navigate to the resource, the `semio-repo: Navigate to` command should navigate to the resource.
summary: Fixed bundle tree items showing raw kind strings (e.g. 'librarysemio/js') instead of emoji-prefixed short names (e.g. '📚js'). Added bundleKindEmoji() mapping function matching the Go CLI's bundleKindEmoji() (schema→🛂, binary→⌨️️️, ui→🖱️️️, site→🌐, assets→🏪, library→📚). Fixed label to extract short name after '/' from full bundle name. Also removed leftover duplicate constructor/refresh in FilterTreeDataProvider. Added bundleKindEmoji tests.
